short_summary: Lego has announced three new Batman sets coming out in early 2027, featuring two different Batmobiles and a detailed Joker wall art piece.

sources.name: Polygon
sources.title: Lego Officially Reveals Three New Batman Sets for Early 2027

sources.name: IGN
sources.title: 3 New Batman LEGO Sets Announced, Including Wall Art of an Iconic Joker Comic Cover

paragraphs: The Lego Company has officially revealed three brand-new Batman sets that will arrive on store shelves on January 1, 2027. These upcoming releases give fans of the Caped Crusader several new building options inspired by classic movies, video games, and comic books.

According to the announcements, the first set is the Batman Returns Batmobile & Duck, which recreates the vehicle from the 1992 film alongside the Penguin's duck-shaped ride. Another vehicle set is the Arkham Batman Batmobile, featuring a 317-piece tank-like design based on the 2015 video game Batman: Arkham Knight. The third and largest set is The Joker Wall Art Comic Cover, an intricate 1,849-piece mural based on a famous 2011 comic book cover featuring a smiling Joker with bats flying out of the frame.

Two of these new Lego sets also include special digital codes. Players can use these codes to unlock gold versions of vehicles and characters inside the video game Lego Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight, which was published by Warner Bros. Games earlier in the year and received strong praise from players and critics.

Fans attending the upcoming New York Comic-Con between October 8 and 11 will have the chance to see all three sets up close at the DC Booth. Lego also announced that original cover artist Jock will sign items at the booth on Thursday, October 8.

facts.fact: Lego announced three new Batman sets scheduled for release on January 1, 2027.
The three sets include the Batman Returns Batmobile & Duck, the Arkham Batman Batmobile, and The Joker Wall Art Comic Cover.
Two of the new Lego sets include codes to unlock gold versions of vehicles in the video game Lego Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight.
Lego Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight was released by Warner Bros. Games on May 22 and received positive reviews.
The sets will be displayed at New York Comic-Con from October 8 to 11.
